hull.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of the Humber
s1loc: Hull carries a live scene that earned it UK City of Culture in 2017. The city-centre Connexin Live, formerly the Bonus Arena, handles the big touring shows, Hull New Theatre and Hull City Hall cover the grand concerts and seated runs, and grassroots rooms like The Welly and the Polar Bear keep the gig calendar full, while the Freedom Festival takes over Trinity Square, Zebedees Yard and the marina across the city centre each late summer.

And the trade runs at every size along the Humber. The arena, Hull New Theatre, festival operators and production companies field big crews and large seasonal teams and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers from the Old Town and Fruit Market outward want just a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier here has to serve the big festival and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side.

derby.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Derbyshire
s1loc: Derby packs a busy live scene into a compact city. Derby Arena hosts the big touring concerts and tribute shows, Derby Theatre anchors the seated runs, and rooms like The Venue, The Flowerpot and the Hairy Dog carry the grassroots gig calendar, while open-air events fill the summer at Darley Park, where the Darley Park Weekender runs, and the nearby Elvaston Castle Country Park hosts large outdoor music weekends beyond the city edge.

And the trade runs at every size across Derbyshire. The arena, Derby Theatre, festival operators and production companies field big crews and large seasonal teams and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers around the Cathedral Quarter and the city centre want just a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier here has to serve the big festival and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side.

Derby backs its city-centre venues with big outdoor dates. The Derby Arena doubles as a velodrome and a concert hall, Derby Theatre and the Guildhall cover the stage side, Deda anchors dance and contemporary work, and the free Darley Park Concert fills the riverside each summer with one of the country's largest outdoor classical audiences. Markeaton Park takes the funfairs and community days, and the city draws crews and production teams from across the East Midlands through the year.

Beyond its main stages, Derby has a deep events calendar. Derby Feste turns the Market Place and Cathedral Quarter into a free weekend of outdoor circus, aerial and street performance, the Roundhouse hosts large indoor events in its restored railway hall, and the QUAD keeps film and digital work running year-round. Add the Cathedral Quarter and St Peters Quarter programmes, the city's long jazz and folk nights and a calendar of food and music days on the Market Place, and Derby keeps production, staging and front-of-house crews working across the centre through every season of the year. The Derby Folk Festival fills a Market Place marquee each autumn, the Hairy Dog and the Venue carry the grassroots gigs, and the city's Pride and Caribbean Carnival bring their own crews onto the streets.

Milton Keynes pairs its arena venues with big outdoor sites. The National Bowl draws stadium-scale concerts, Campbell Park takes the city's large open-air festivals and firework nights, and The Stables at Wavendon, founded by Cleo Laine and John Dankworth, runs a year-round music programme. With the theatre, the gallery and Xscape all in the central core, the city keeps crews and front-of-house teams working across a spread-out, fast-growing events town.
